hook: Jo tumhare saath soya hai, wo tumhara dost nahi hai...
feedback: Great twist ending and very high tension in the final beats. However, to max out 'emotion' and 'dialogue' scores: 1) Build slightly more warmth/character bond in the intro cuts (cut 4) so we care deeply if Kabir is lost. 2) Cut 12 romanized text has a typo: 'mehta chillara' instead of 'chilla'. 3) Ensure narrator lines are strictly Devanagari with English words in English script (e.g. 'phone' and 'screen' can be in English script in Roman, but check Devanagari consistency). Overall, strong, punchy execution. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes,
lines: Jo tumhare saath soya hai, wo tumhara dost nahi hai...
Aman ko laga ki Kabir bahar jangal mein ro raha hai.
Kasol ke is safed peepal ke paas camp lagana mana tha.
Par Aman aur Kabir ne lok-kathaon ko mahaz ek afwaah samjha.
Raat ke do baje, Kabir tent se bahar nikla.
Kuch hi der mein, ghane andhere se cheekh ki awaaz aayi.
Aman! Bachao mujhe! Ye ped mujhe kheench raha hai!
Aman ghabraakar utha, tabhi zameen par pada Kabir ka phone baja.
Aman ki nazar bagal wali sleeping bag par gayi...
Wahan koi Kabir ki jacket pehenkar so raha tha.
Kabir? Tum yahan ho... toh bahar kaun mehta chillara raha hai?
Bagal mein soye us saaye ne dheere se apna chehra ghumaya.
Bahar jo hai... wo asal mein tumhe bacha raha tha, Aman.
Ped ne awaaz nahi badli thi... ped ne toh dost ko hi badal diya tha.
